name: Victor Negrescu - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 2/2025 of the European Union for the financial year 2025 - Update of revenue (own resources) and adjustments to expenditure
part_text:
The European Parliament approves the Council's position on amending the European Union's 2025 budget. The changes update the money coming in — customs duties, value added tax, plastic waste contributions and fines — and adjust spending, mainly adding 3.5 billion euros for rural development payments. The Parliament also gives its views: it wants new sources of income for the European Union budget, warns against repeatedly moving money between programmes, and supports extra funds to help Bulgaria prepare to adopt the euro.

- Changes: income forecasts updated; 3.5 billion euros more for rural development payments.
- Affects: farmers receiving rural funds, Bulgaria's euro preparations, and member states' contributions.
- Next: the amended budget is adopted and published in the Official Journal.
